thread.title: Stop Comparing Elon Musk To Steve Jobs (Podcast) - Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA)

author: Quoth the Raven
title: Stop Comparing Elon Musk To Steve Jobs (Podcast) - Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA)
text:
The comparisons between Tesla's ( TSLA ) Elon Musk and Apple's ( AAPL ) Steve Jobs need to stop. In this podcast, I make my case as to why I don’t believe this association is accurate and draw attention to some similarities and differences between the two people.
Even from his early age in his late teens, Steve Jobs always had a focus on turning a profit. In this podcast, I recall several stories that Steve Wozniak told about Jobs buying surplus electronic parts and turning around and selling them at a huge profit. Even as the two were in their early 20's, Jobs was helping Wozniak sell his blue box devices that he was making for $75, for $150, a profit of $75.
Further, I draw a comparison between the Apple II and Tesla's Model 3. Both are supposed to be the mainstream "mass production every day model" products for consumers of each of their respective companies. In the case of Apple, the Apple II was a tremendous success that instantly turned the company into a cash flow generative and profitable entity before it IPO'd, whereas the Model 3 for Tesla is still not being consistently delivered at the price point that it was promised, probably because, as Elon said this weekend in a tweet, it would "cause Tesla to 'lose money and die'".
Also in this podcast, I run down a little history of Apple and Tesla and talk about the early days of each company. Finally, I arrive at the conclusion that it is definitely going to take another 5 or 10 years - at least - before we know whether or not Musk will turn out anything like Steve Jobs. But, as I argue early on in the podcast, immortalization and legendary status that people like Steve Jobs have acquired, must come organically from the people and can’t be labeled by the media.
